name: units_display_name_leak
source:
{ Minimal repro distilled from the brayton-cycle example: the `K` inside the
  unit annotation [J/kg-K] must NOT register a display name for the variable k.
  Java records k -> "k" (from the equation on line 2); an engine that lets unit
  tokens enter the display-name table wins the first-seen race with "K". }
cp = 1004 [J/kg-K]
k = 1.4
q = cp * k
